segment_captions.caption: C walks outside, passing a water barrel and a blue bucket filled with soil.
C walks from the garden area towards the grassy lawn, passing by a blue bucket filled with soil and a white water barrel with a hose attached.
C picks up a green trash bin from the grass.
C picks up a green trash bin from the grass and holds it steady while reaching for a white plastic pipe lying on the ground next to the bin.
C opens a trash bin and places a white plastic sheet inside it.

C picks up a white plastic sheet from the ground and places it into a trash bin.

C picks up a piece of wood from the floor with their right hand while holding a nail gun in their left hand. The wood is placed against a wall, and C adjusts its position with both hands.

C adjusts a drawer handle with his right hand while holding a hose with his left hand. The drawer is partially open, revealing a dark carpet underneath. C's left leg is bent, and he is kneeling on the floor. The hose is coiled on the floor next to him.

C picks up a white trim board from the floor and inspects it closely.

C picks up a piece of baseboard from the floor and places it against the wall, then walks away with it.
C opens the door and steps outside, revealing a cluttered area with construction materials and tools scattered around.

C walks down the stairs and reaches for a tool on the ground.
